manifest.name: customer-import-row
manifest.description: The receipt for one input row of an applied import: what it was, what happened to it, and which deterministic rule decided. Every rejected row has one of these, and accepted + rejected + skipped equals the run's row count exactly - a rejected row never disappears quietly.

migrations.name: create_customer_import_rows
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_import_rows (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  run_id TEXT,
  row_index INTEGER,
  input_digest TEXT,
  outcome TEXT CHECK(outcome IN ('accepted', 'rejected', 'skipped')),
  reason_code TEXT,
  reason TEXT,
  match_rule TEXT,
  subject_resource TEXT,
  subject_id TEXT,
  subject_owner TEXT CHECK(subject_owner IN ('host', 'package')),
  subject_owner_package TEXT,
  subject_label TEXT,
  created_subject INTEGER CHECK(created_subject IN (0, 1)),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS customer_import_rows_run_id ON customer_import_rows(run_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS customer_import_rows_outcome ON customer_import_rows(outcome);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS customer_import_rows_subject_resource ON customer_import_rows(subject_resource);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS customer_import_rows_subject_id ON customer_import_rows(subject_id);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_customer_import_rows
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."customer_import_rows" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "run_id" TEXT,
  "row_index" BIGINT,
  "input_digest" TEXT,
  "outcome" TEXT CHECK("outcome" IN ('accepted', 'rejected', 'skipped')),
  "reason_code" TEXT,
  "reason" TEXT,
  "match_rule" TEXT,
  "subject_resource" TEXT,
  "subject_id" TEXT,
  "subject_owner" TEXT CHECK("subject_owner" IN ('host', 'package')),
  "subject_owner_package" TEXT,
  "subject_label" TEXT,
  "created_subject" BOOLEAN,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "customer_import_rows_run_id"
  ON "accordo"."customer_import_rows"("run_id");

CREATE INDEX "customer_import_rows_outcome"
  ON "accordo"."customer_import_rows"("outcome");

CREATE INDEX "customer_import_rows_subject_resource"
  ON "accordo"."customer_import_rows"("subject_resource");

CREATE INDEX "customer_import_rows_subject_id"
  ON "accordo"."customer_import_rows"("subject_id");
